slate.name: Slate
slate.hub.title: Slate
slate.hub.edit_layout.tip: Open the layout editor on the screen behind this one (needs dev mode)
slate.hub.no_modules.body: Slate UI, Multiplayer, Chat and Config each add a card here. Core alone restyles vanilla screens and provides the toolkit.
slate.settings.title: Slate settings
slate.settings.dev_mode.tip: Adds the pencil button to editable screens and enables the F7 layout editor
slate.settings.restyle.hint: Which other screens get Slate's widgets, backgrounds and tooltips with the custom menu style. Inventories and containers follow the container switch above instead.
slate.settings.reset.title: Reset Slate settings?
slate.settings.reset.body: Every option on this page goes back to its default. Layouts and module settings are kept.
slate.setup.title: Set up Slate
slate.setup.subtitle: Pick how much Slate changes. Everything can be changed later, per menu too.
slate.setup.hint: Change these any time in Slate settings.
slate.setup.layout.desc: Slate's rebuilt menus replace vanilla's: a new title screen with a continue card, world and server lists with search and favourites, a compact pause menu and an options hub. Off: vanilla's own screens and button placement, with a Slate button on the title and pause screens.
slate.setup.style.desc: The dark modern look for every menu: layered panels, an accent colour, pixel-stepped corners. Off: vanilla's stone buttons and panels, still animated.
slate.setup.containers.desc: Inventories, chests, furnaces and other container screens get Slate's panel, sunken slot wells, an accent hover ring and light labels. Off: their own textures. Works with either menu style.
slate.toast.test.title: Notifications work
slate.toast.test.body: This is what a Slate toast looks like. Click to dismiss.
slate.action.arg.name: Name
slate.action.arg.title: Title
slate.layout.vanilla.desc: Minecraft's own screens and button placement, with a Slate button on the title and pause screens.
slate.layout.custom.desc: Slate's rebuilt screens: a title screen with a continue card, world and server lists with search and favourites, a compact pause menu and the options hub.
slate.layout.overhaul.desc: Animated 3D scenes built from real Minecraft blocks, players and items. Needs Slate UI.
slate.style.slate.desc: The dark modern look: layered panels, an accent colour, pixel-stepped corners.
slate.style.vanilla.desc: Vanilla's stone buttons and panels, still animated.
slate.slot.title: Title screen
slate.slot.unavailable.layout: %s is not available for this menu
slate.module.slate.pitch: The theme, the widget toolkit, the restyle of vanilla screens, the layout editor and the hub.
slate.module.slate_menu.pitch: The rebuilt and the overhauled menus: title, play, pause, options, world creation and the loading screens.
slate.module.slate_config.pitch: One settings screen for the whole game and every mod.
slate.module.slate_multiplayer.pitch: Friends, groups, presence, messages, invites and screen sharing.
slate.module.slate_chat.pitch: The in-game chat rebuilt: channels, media, emotes, history and search.
slate.module.slate_building.pitch: Every block's shapes on a wheel, placement ghosts and a build menu with twenty modes.
slate.module.slate_profile.pitch: Looks and skins, cosmetics, a profile picture and bio, and the account switcher.
slate.feature_test.title: Feature gates
slate.settings.menus.desc: Each menu Slate touches can follow the global layout and style or use its own. A layout a menu cannot show right now is greyed out and says why.
slate.layout.not_yet: No menu has an Overhaul screen yet
slate.setup.needs_ui: Install Slate UI to choose the Custom or Overhaul layout; until then every menu is Minecraft's own, in the style chosen below.
slate.setup.no_overhaul_yet: The Overhaul layout appears here once a menu has an Overhaul screen.
